note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation in this sermon was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS New Testament wording and the self_rendered Old Testament wording the first translation carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, verses joined, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'; a verbatim recitation without quote marks counts (founder rule, 2026-11-19). `self_rendered` rows each carry a `why`: allusions left in Whitefield's prose, his own paraphrases, and verses he recasts to another person.

Judgement calls: the text 'And Enoch walked with God' is OWB Gen 5:24 «ሄኖክ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ተመላለሰ» wherever it is quoted, while the sermon's own subject 'walking with God' stays «ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር መሄድ» in the prose (OWB's 1 John 2:6 uses the same ተመላለሰ, so the link holds). 'Search the scriptures' (John 5:39) and 'It is written' (Matt 4:4) stay Whitefield's: OWB words the first as a statement and has no one-word form of the second. 'Come, let us go up to the house of the Lord' is cited from Ps 122:1 (where 'glad when they said' comes from), not Micah 4:2. 'Watch and pray, that ye enter not' is Matt 26:41. Whitefield's '(or, this woman)' gloss on Gen 3:12 stands between two OWB pieces, and the prose that follows takes OWB's 'placed with me'. The prose 'Jehovah' is እግዚአብሔር (am.json decision `jehovah`), and Esther's king is አሕሻዊሮስ as OWB names him (the first translation had Artaxerxes).
